events.title: Data-center-backed IT load growth stressing local transformers and substations
events.summary: Localized data-center load growth may be increasing transformer and substation stress, which could compress procurement windows and escalate outage risk if not monitored.

events.title: Renewable integration changing substation equipment demand profile
events.summary: Inverter-rich generation may change substation protection and transformer specification needs, with procurement and reinforcement implications if sustained.

events.title: Critical-mineral and logistics signals affecting transformer manufacturing capacity
events.summary: Upstream material and logistics stress may reduce short-term transformer manufacturing throughput, increasing scheduling and sourcing risk for high-voltage projects.

events.title: OEM capacity allocation and lead-time pressure in short-cycle vs. specialized HV products
events.summary: Capacity shifts toward short-cycle products may lengthen delivery times for specialized high-voltage units, forcing trade-offs in project execution.

events.title: On-site generation and BESS adoption by data centers could alter distribution tie-in patterns
events.summary: Wider adoption of on-site generation and BESS at data centers may lower feeder peak exposure but increase substation protection complexity and control requirements.

events.title: Inverter proliferation creating protection and control complexity at transmission/distribution interface
events.summary: Growing inverter-based generation could force protection scheme changes at the transmission/distribution interface, increasing engineering workload and potential short-term operational risk.

events.title: Competition for critical minerals between HV equipment and EV sectors may increase procurement pressure
events.summary: Cross-sector competition for the same minerals may elevate procurement risk for HV equipment if demand windows overlap, affecting timelines and cost.

events.title: Policy and grid-code movement may speed DER interconnection and shift upgrade timelines
events.summary: Faster DER interconnection policies could accelerate distribution upgrade demand, concentrating procurement and engineering workloads in shorter windows.

events.title: Rapid BESS deployments changing substation loading patterns and ancillary service flows
events.summary: BESS rollouts may alter substation thermal and operational profiles, reducing some peaks while introducing high-frequency cycling and control complexity.

events.title: AI-based forecasting tools may shift procurement and operational timing
events.summary: AI forecasting can both reduce operational uncertainty and concentrate procurement timing, which may create new windows of supply risk if forecasting leads to synchronized ordering.
